question: In triangleABC, ∠B = 87° and ∠C = 60°. Points D and E are on the sides AB and AC, respectively, such that ∠DEC = 93° and DE ∶ BC = 5 ∶ 9. If AB = 14.4 cm, then the length of AE is:
solution:
Given:

ΔABC, ∠B = 87° and ∠C = 60

∠DEC = 93° and DE ∶ BC = 5 ∶ 9.

AB = 14.4 cm

Concept used:

The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°

The sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral is 360°

The ratios of the corresponding sides of similar triangles are the same. 

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63151443f82a151f002614d7591ef8790e7bd60f62e49e754bdd183a50dee0f0.png] 

Considering, ΔABC, ∠A = 180° - 87° - 60° = 33° 

Now, considering the quadrilateral BCED,

∠EDB = 360° - 93° - 60° - 87° = 120°

Hence, 

ADB being a straight line, ∠ADE = 180° - 120° = 60°

AEC being a straight line, ∠AED = 180° - 93° = 87°

Hence, ΔADE and ΔACB are similar triangles.

Now,

DE/BC = AE/AB

⇒ AE = (DE/BC) × AB

⇒ AE = 5/9 × 14.4

⇒ AE = 8

**∴ The length of AE is 8 cm.**
